scope: Local source inspection plus requested Sentinel verification and production build. No application changes or AWS calls were made.

Cognito OAuth authorization-code flow with PKCE, state/nonce/token validation, refresh, sign-out; client-side session uses sessionStorage.

assessment.verification: npm.cmd run test:sentinel passed 14/14 checks. Test log: test-sentinel.log. It uses stubbed HTTP/Cognito responses and verifies client behavior, not AWS service health.
assessment.runtime_evidence: Prior UI verification supplied in task context: two stored test events were displayed; sentinel-test001 remained acknowledged after reload. This is evidence of persisted test-event status, not evidence of genuine threat activity. No live request was made during this evidence-gathering task.

assessment.classification: partial overall; core listing, versions, download URL, and UI history/recovery flows runtime verified; compliance/WORM behavior unverified

source_evidence.finding: Vault API base defaults to the w5vwnekg26 API; code lists files, requests upload URLs and PUTs bytes to the returned S3 URL. List failures fall back to fixture files and set isLive false.
Code requests download URLs, lists versions, and sends restore requests; demo branches exist for downloads, versions, and restore.
UI context invokes live-aware file refresh, upload, download and restore service methods and exposes errors/demo state.
UI has separate live and simulated-storage status; its demo copy says rollback/metadata/WORM checks simulate S3.

assessment.limitation: AWS compliance, WORM/Object Lock, retention guarantees, and AWS account-side resource configuration remain unverified because the athena profile failed authentication. No actual restore was issued in this read-only check.
assessment.verification: GET /api/files via local Vite proxy returned HTTP 200 with 13 entries (not asserted as full inventory); version history for demo/athena-test.txt returned HTTP 200 with 5 versions; download-url returned HTTP 200 and expiresIn 300 seconds (signed URL withheld). Task-shared UI check reported live mode, version history, and recovery confirmation loaded.

assessment.classification: local image OCR implemented and runtime verified; Textract/PDF analysis remains demo or planned in this checkout

source_evidence.finding: Enterprise presets are tagged isDemoSample=true. Uploaded PNG/JPG/JPEG images are OCRed in-browser with Tesseract.js; PDFs are rejected by the local OCR path and image size is limited to 25 MB.
Local OCR results are stored in app state; other submitted document payloads use ApiService.analyzeDocument.
Document GET/analyze endpoints are labelled proposed; request failures fall back to static/sample generated Textract-like data marked demo.
Panel distinguishes mock Textract sample output from Tesseract local OCR output.
README describes the UI as emulating Textract/Comprehend and labels backend contracts proposed.

assessment.limitation: No Textract call is present in the inspected local document workflow. The teammate's separately developed upstream work was not available in this checkout. OCR evidence does not verify Textract.
assessment.verification: Task-shared fresh-session sample completed through local Tesseract with 16 words, 130 characters, and 91.0% engine confidence. Engine confidence is not benchmark accuracy.
